aboutCompany.title: A 3-Generation Family Enterprise Delivering Excellence
aboutCompany.paragraph1: Starting fresh produce cultivation in 1945, our company has steadily expanded production capacity and quality over more than 70 years, thriving as a third-generation family business.
aboutCompany.paragraph2: Building upon our domestic reputation in the 1980s, Meypal expanded exports across the Middle East and Balkans, moving into Russia and European markets in the 1990s. Since the early 2000s, our seasoned team has managed year-round export operations sourced from premier agricultural regions across Turkey.

hero.title: 70 Years of Trust and Export Excellence From Nature to Table
hero.description: Starting our production journey in 1945, today we operate a comprehensive global supply network based in Turkey and the United Kingdom. Delivering produce with day-one freshness to tables worldwide 12 months a year.

story.title: A Journey of Excellence from Soil to Global Markets
story.paragraph1: Starting fresh fruit and vegetable production in 1945, our company continues its operations as a third-generation family business, continuously enhancing its production capacity and product quality with over 70 years of experience.
story.paragraph2: Transforming its domestic market success into export excellence during the 1980s, primarily to the Middle East and Balkan countries, our company expanded this network to Russia and European countries from the 1990s onward. By the early 2000s, with an experienced team, it became a leading enterprise conducting export operations 12 months a year across every corner of Turkey.

globalHubs.description: Embracing global economic dynamics in the 2000s, our company shifted focus and investments toward Europe, primarily the UK. With our joint enterprise established in 2012 at London's New Spitalfields Market and Meypal Tarım in Turkey, we continue to advance with confident strides in the industry.

turkey.title: Meypal Turkey
turkey.description: As Meypal Turkey, we pack our products to European standards in contracted facilities across key agricultural hubs including Mersin, Antalya, Denizli, Manisa, and Bursa. Working with specialized logistics partners, we preserve the cold chain and deliver produce with day-one freshness—as if freshly picked from the branch—to European dining tables via road, air, and sea freight.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.statement: As Meypal Turkey Export, we increased our export volume from 15,000 tons in 2013 to 30,000 tons in 2015 and approximately 40,000 tons in 2016. Our target is to lead the sector with 60,000 tons of export produce. As London Meypal Import, we grew our import volume from 5,000 tons in 2013 to 20,000 tons in 2015 and 30,000 tons in 2016; today, together with nearly 70 suppliers worldwide beyond Meypal Turkey, we aim to achieve our 50,000-ton import target, expanding our investments and generating greater employment.
vision.subtext: Combining our rooted agricultural strength in Mersin with our global distribution hub in London, we scale sustainably with nearly 70 international supply partners worldwide.

readyToEat.title: Ready to Eat Products
readyToEat.subtitle: High-efficiency, fresh, and convenient solutions for the processing industry and convenience market
readyToEat.intro: As a market leader in lettuce, Meypal is positioned right at the heart of the convenience market and maintains close contact with the processing industry. We work in close cooperation with all stakeholders in our business field, treating their challenges as our own to devise solution strategies and introduce new products. Our primary aim in developing specialized breeding programs is achieving long shelf life, vibrant color, and superior taste.

items.title: Convenience Market & Processing Industry
items.description: As a market leader in lettuce, Meypal is positioned right at the heart of the convenience market and maintains close contact with the processing industry. We work in close cooperation with all stakeholders in our business field, treating their challenges as our own to devise solution strategies and introduce new products. Our primary aim in developing specialized breeding programs is achieving long shelf life, vibrant color, and superior taste.
items.imageAlt: Meypal fresh greens and vegetable processing preparation
items.highlight: Long shelf life, vibrant natural colors, and top-tier taste standards

items.title: Specific Attributes & High Profitability
items.description: For this industry, attractive appearance and great flavor alone are not enough. Among numerous specific demands, minimal waste during packaging, excellent presentation, and extended shelf life are of utmost importance. Growers' expectations for high yield and lower labor requirements are equally met. Meypal’s diverse range of vegetables allows processing companies and growers alike to maximize profitability.
items.imageAlt: Ready to eat packaged fresh salad and vegetables bowl
items.highlight: Low packaging waste, pristine presentation, and optimal shelf life

items.title: Cooperation & Strong Partnerships
items.description: Selecting the right variety demands close collaboration. Beyond the intrinsic traits of the crop, fertilization and irrigation conditions play a vital role in delivering a successful end-consumer product. Additionally, washability, processability, and storage stability are indispensable requirements. This is where our knowledge sharing with partners takes center stage—the definitive way to achieve optimal results from every variety. To anticipate demands from global markets, we maintain ongoing ties and joint projects with international convenience food specialists.
items.imageAlt: Salanova convenient fresh lettuce leaves emblem
items.highlight: Optimized washability, processability, and cold storage resilience

items.title: Proven Success: Salanova® & Caribbean Melon
items.description: In the convenience food category, Salanova® exemplifies a standout lettuce variety that separates into countless individual leaves with a single cut. Another highlight is the Caribbean Cantaloupe melon, featuring enhanced shelf life. Its thin, smooth rind and compact seed cavity make it exceptionally attractive for the processing sector. With mechanical lettuce harvesting becoming standard, manual factory cutting is obsolete. Our sweet, crisp varieties are perfectly suited for automated processing.
items.highlight: Single-cut Salanova® and high-yield, long shelf life Caribbean melon
